channel.title: The Foamies blog
channel.description: Surf spots, tips for beginners and stories from the Foamies community.

item.title: Surfing Alone: When to Go and How to Enjoy It Safely
item.description: Surfing alone can be pure joy when you feel comfortable, know the break and have other surfers in the water. When to go, good habits to keep, and how to find a surf buddy if you want one.

item.title: How to Read a Surf Forecast: Swell, Period and Wind
item.description: Swell height, swell period, wind and tide: a simple way to read a surf forecast in a few minutes and know if the waves suit your level.

item.title: Surfing in Taghazout, Morocco: Spots, Levels and Tips
item.description: Anchor Point, Killer Point, Banana Beach, Devil's Rock: Taghazout and Tamraght surf spots sorted by level, with the best season and practical tips.

item.title: Surfing in Morocco: The Best Spots for a Surf Trip
item.description: From Rabat to Imsouane and Essaouira: Morocco's surf spots sorted by level, which waves are expert only, and the best time of year for your surf trip.

item.title: Wetsuit Thickness Guide: What to Wear by Water Temperature
item.description: Spring suit, 3/2, 4/3 or 5/4? A simple chart to match your wetsuit thickness to the water temperature, plus the fit and accessories that keep you warm.

item.title: Winter Surfing in Europe: Where to Surf from November to March
item.description: The Canary Islands, Portugal or the Basque Country: where to go winter surfing in Europe for your level, which wetsuit to pack and which spots to leave to experts.
